title: Ya Ghareeb Ul Ghuraba
body:
Ya Ghareeb Ul Ghuraba
Ya Moein Al Zohafa
Kushta E Zulm O Sitam Aye Fidya E Rab E Ulaa
Haaif Mamoon A Shaqi Da Dah Taura Zehr E Dagha
1. Khudsiyan Ba Arshe Girya Nandh Az Zulm O Chuni Arshiyan
Zaro Hazeen
Zeen Alam Masghool E Girya'd Gasht Shah E Dosara
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Aah Az Zulm O Sitam Mamoon E Be Reham O Shaqi
Dushman E Aa'n Mutaqi
Dar Aanab Da Dah Tau Ad Jor O Jafa Zehr E Dagha
